tools.name: sites_wifi_create-broadcast
tools.description: Create a new Wifi Broadcast on the specified site. Required: siteId, channel2gLockedTo6 (default: false), clientIsolationEnabled, dtimPeriod2gLockedTo3 (default: false), enabled, hideName, multicastToUnicastConversionEnabled, name, securityConfiguration, type, uapsdEnabled. Optional: basicDataRateKbpsByFrequencyGHz, blackoutScheduleConfiguration, broadcastingDeviceFilter (plus 4 more). Returns the new WifiBroadcastDetails.

params.name: broadcastingDeviceFilter
params.description: Defines the custom scope of devices that will broadcast this WiFi network. If null, the WiFi network will be broadcast by all Access Point capable devices.

params.name: channel2gLockedTo6
params.description: Locks 2.4GHz radio channel to 6 on all broadcasting devices

params.name: dtimPeriod2gLockedTo3
params.description: Locks DTIM period to 3 for 2.4GHz radio

params.name: uapsdEnabled
params.description: Indicates whether Unscheduled Automatic Power Save Delivery (U-APSD) is enabled

tools.name: sites_wifi_delete-broadcast
